- region "Reward early supporters":
  - heading "Reward early supporters" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Earlier purchased support receives more weight. One person buying several periods advances the window as much as several people buying the same total.
  - group "Early-support reward strength":
    - text: Early-support reward strength
    - radio "None 1×"
    - strong: None
    - text: 1×
    - radio "Some 1.5×"
    - strong: Some
    - text: 1.5×
    - radio "More 3×"
    - strong: More
    - text: 3×
    - radio "Custom Your terms" [checked]
    - strong: Custom
    - text: Your terms
  - text: Starting boost (×)
  - paragraph: 1–10, in steps of 0.01. A boost of 1 means None.
  - textbox "Starting boost (×)": "2.37"
  - paragraph
  - text: Early-support window (purchased periods)
  - paragraph: "A positive whole number of purchased membership periods. Default: 1,000. None has no window."
  - textbox "Early-support window (purchased periods)":
    - /placeholder: "1000"
    - text: "42"
  - paragraph
  - paragraph:
    - strong: Custom.
    - text: Reward weight starts at 2.37× and tapers to the normal 1× rate across 42 purchased periods.
  - paragraph: At launch, one purchased period receives 2.3536× average weight. Larger purchases span more of the taper.
  - paragraph: Weight determines a member’s share of rewards earned while eligible. It is not a cash payout or a promised return.
  - paragraph: "Boost and window are permanent when published. A zero contribution adds access only: no new weight, no funded rewards, and no reactivation of suspended weight."
